posts.title: Continuing a style isn't the same as starting one
posts.description: AI is good at compounding decisions. The faster it gets at continuing a style or system, the more consequential the starting point becomes.

posts.title: The system I no longer know by heart
posts.description: When an agent does much of the production work, I stop knowing the design system by heart. The knowledge has to move out of my head and into the system.

posts.title: Where decisions live
posts.description: Slack for discussion, meetings to resolve, notes for thinking, and a dated decisions log for where things landed. Why agents need that structure too.
